metadata.title: PR 6 — Quiz smoke test
metadata.purpose: Validates Quiz component (single-answer mode) with options array, reveal, explanation, and score badge.

props.question: Which compilation strategy runs at application startup?

options.label: Just-In-Time (JIT)
options.explanation: JIT compiles methods on first call, not at startup.

options.label: Ahead-Of-Time (AOT)
options.explanation: AOT compiles before the app runs — at build time, not startup.

options.label: ReadyToRun startup compilation
options.explanation: Correct — ReadyToRun pre-compiles IL to native at startup.

props.teacherNote: Tip: ReadyToRun is .NET's hybrid AOT/JIT model.
